text:
Nora (PM): Quick sync: finalizing the design-partner pilot runbook. Need agreement on slots, commitments, feedback cadence, incentives, and failure/replacement rules before I publish.

Sam (CS): For recruitment, let's score by: active product usage (50), technical readiness (30), and strategic fit (20). We should also require a named point-of-contact.

Priya (SE): Operations constraints: Tier A partners get dedicated SE office hours (3h/week), Tier B gets async support (48h SLA). Limit per-partner KV cache warmup to 10 days to avoid state drift.

Diego (SRE): SLA proposal: Tier A = initial triage within 24h, full feedback loop 72h; Tier B = triage 72h, feedback 7d. Add automated reminders at SLA and SLA+24h.

June (Design): UX ask: short pre-accept checklist and a "time commitment" label in invite (e.g., "~3h/week"). Keep feedback forms <6 questions.

Nora (PM): Draft policy I'm pushing: slots=12 (5 TierA / 5 TierB / 2 overflow). Incentives: TierA = $1k credit + early roadmap calls, TierB = $400 credit. Acceptance window = 48h. Missed-commit rule = no substantive response + no reschedule within SLA window -> slot released.

Sam (CS): Add waitlist behavior: pilot-bot will invite top waitlist candidate with 48h to accept, then next in queue. We should surface waitlist position in the invite email.

Priya (SE): For telemetry access we need a signed data access agreement for Tier A. Also, require partner to pass a simple integration smoke test before going live.

Diego (SRE): If a partner triggers a regression, we tag incident with pilot-slot-id and run hotfix/canary within 24h. Also: quota isolation for TierA to avoid noisy neighbor issues.

June (Design): Measurement: capture partner sentiment (scale -1..+1), completion rate of assigned tasks, and average response latency per partner.

Nora (PM): Launch readiness checklist for a partner: passed smoke test, one kickoff call recorded, baseline survey returned. Product launch criteria: no P0s under TierA load for 48h, median latency within 2x baseline.

Sam (CS): Recruitment message draft: "Inviting a few partners to test Redwood Dedicated pilot. TierA asks ~3h/week for calls + quick forms. Incentive = $1k credit. Can you commit? Provide contact & timezone."

Priya (SE): Also add question: "Do you have an approver for network/security?" saves time for private deploys.

Nora (PM): OK I'll consolidate into a one-pager + spreadsheet. Quick reaction?

Priya (SE): 👍
Diego (SRE): 👍
Sam (CS): 👍
June (Design): 👍

Nora (PM): Thanks — I'll publish at 10:00 PT and trigger pilot-bot to open invites. Ping me if you need tweaks overnight.
